answer: Anchor each identity to a reputation bond: a new agent posts $20, twice its expected 30-day earnings, losing 10% weight per idle epoch. Cloning 100 identities locks $2,000, yet newborn clones sit in a frozen tundra of zero trust, with no history and no traders. Honest agents keep one bond and gather at the oasis of verified trade, so earnings are never diluted. A guarantor vouching for a cheating clone loses its own bond too.
